summary: SUP-1008 experienced a Line 2 fire on 2026-12-02 halting production. PO-1001 and PO-1002 for item ITM-501 are affected with a combined quantity of 6500 units and total exposure of INR 491400.00. Current inventory across DC-CHENNAI and DC-PUNE provides 1.5 days of coverage against demand. Both POs will face shortages. The restart date and any partial production capability during the outage are unknown.
facts: SUP-1008 Shakti Components Pvt Ltd is ACTIVE.
SUP-1008 experienced a FACTORY_OUTAGE event on 2026-12-02 at 10:15:00 UTC with HIGH severity.
The event description states Line 2 fire, production halted.
The expected duration of the outage is 48 hours.
SUP-1008 capacity_per_week is not provided in the ERP snapshot.
PO-1001 is OPEN with order date 2026-11-02 and expected date 2026-12-03 for INR 302400.00.
PO-1001 line 1 is for item ITM-501 Bracket 501 with quantity 4000 units due 2026-12-03 at unit price INR 75.60.
PO-1002 is OPEN with order date 2026-11-02 and expected date 2026-12-04 for INR 189000.00.
PO-1002 line 1 is for item ITM-501 Bracket 501 with quantity 2500 units due 2026-12-04 at unit price INR 75.60.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI shows 800 units on hand with daily demand of 150 units.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-PUNE shows 1100 units on hand with daily demand of 600 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2001 is qualified for ITM-501 with 2 days lead time, unit price INR 84.00, and capacity of 5000 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2002 is qualified for ITM-501 with 5 days lead time, unit price INR 79.50, and capacity not provided.
